name: Insurance
tagline: Summarize claim documents and compare them with policy terms for an authorized reviewer.

useCases.title: Claim intake and triage
useCases.description: Turn a first notice of loss into a structured claim file, flag missing documents, and route by severity for a handler to review.

useCases.title: Coverage checking
useCases.description: Compare a claim against the policy wording, find relevant clauses and exclusions, and quote the language that applies.

useCases.title: Document summarization
useCases.description: Condense medical records, adjuster reports, and correspondence into a timeline of facts a handler can verify.

useCases.title: Underwriting support
useCases.description: Extract risk factors from an application, compare against your appetite guidelines, and draft a referral note for review.

useCases.title: Fraud signal flagging
useCases.description: Scan a claim for inconsistencies and known red flags, listing each signal with the document and line it came from.

useCases.title: Policyholder correspondence
useCases.description: Draft claim updates and information requests from the policy and claim record.

faq.q: Is policyholder data safe with Ryu?
faq.a: Yes. With a local model, policyholder data stays on your machine. For cloud models, Gateway rules can block or redact personal data and log each call. Analytics and crash reports are on by default and can be turned off.

faq.q: Can it answer coverage questions accurately?
faq.a: Add your policy wordings and underwriting guidelines to a Space. Answers cite the clause or exclusion, so a handler can verify the basis before relying on it.

faq.q: Does it decide claims on its own?
faq.a: No. Ryu drafts triage, coverage notes, and correspondence for a qualified handler or underwriter to decide. Workflow history shows each run, and the audit trail records which model ran and when.
